items.q: Which of these is a pure substance?
items.explain: Distilled water is one compound, H₂O, so it is a pure substance.
items.explainAf: Gedistilleerde water is een verbinding, H₂O, dus is dit ’n suiwer stof.

items.q: Which method separates salt from salt water?
items.qAf: Watter metode skei sout van soutwater?
items.explain: Evaporating the water leaves the salt behind as a solid.
items.explainAf: Deur die water te laat verdamp, bly die sout as ’n vastestof oor.

items.q: Which method separates sand from water?
items.qAf: Watter metode skei sand van water?
items.explain: Sand is insoluble and is caught by the filter paper, while the water passes through.
items.explainAf: Sand is onoplosbaar en word deur die filterpapier vasgevang, terwyl die water deurgaan.

items.q: Which of these is an element?
items.explain: O₂ contains only one type of atom (oxygen), so it is an element.
items.explainAf: O₂ bevat net een tipe atoom (suurstof), dus is dit ’n element.

items.q: How many atoms are in one molecule of glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆?
items.qAf: Hoeveel atome is in een molekule glukose, C₆H₁₂O₆?

items.q: How does a compound differ from a mixture?
options: A compound has a fixed composition and chemical bonds
A mixture has a fixed composition
A compound can be separated by filtration
optionsAf: ’n Verbinding het ’n vaste samestelling en chemiese bindings
’n Verbinding kan deur filtrasie geskei word
items.explain: A compound is chemically bonded in a fixed ratio; a mixture is not and can be separated physically.
items.explainAf: ’n Verbinding is chemies gebind in ’n vaste verhouding; ’n mengsel is nie en kan fisies geskei word nie.

items.q: A mixture with a uniform composition throughout, such as salt water.
items.qAf: ’n Mengsel met ’n eenvormige samestelling deurgaans, soos soutwater.

items.q: A substance that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means.
items.qAf: ’n Stof wat nie deur chemiese middele in eenvoudiger stowwe afgebreek kan word nie.

items.q: The ability of a material to conduct heat.
items.qAf: Die vermoë van ’n materiaal om hitte te gelei.

items.q: A material that conducts electricity better than an insulator but not as well as a metal, such as silicon.
items.qAf: ’n Materiaal wat elektrisiteit beter as ’n isolator gelei, maar nie so goed soos ’n metaal nie, soos silikon.

items.text: A mixture whose parts can be seen, such as sand and water, is [[]]. Iron is attracted to a magnet because it is [[]].
items.textAf: ’n Mengsel waarvan die dele gesien kan word, soos sand en water, is [[]]. Yster word deur ’n magneet aangetrek omdat dit [[]] is.

items.q: Brass is a mixture of copper and zinc.
items.qAf: Geelkoper is ’n mengsel van koper en sink.
items.explain: True. Brass is an alloy, which is a mixture of metals.
items.explainAf: Waar. Geelkoper is ’n allooi, wat ’n mengsel van metale is.

items.q: Pure water is a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen.
items.qAf: Suiwer water is ’n mengsel van waterstof en suurstof.
items.explain: False. Water is a compound: hydrogen and oxygen are chemically bonded in a fixed ratio (H₂O).
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Water is ’n verbinding: waterstof en suurstof is chemies verbind in ’n vaste verhouding (H₂O).

items.q: Match each substance in column A with its classification in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke stof in kolom A by sy klassifikasie in kolom B.
